column1: Origin of the Mage-OS Extension Directory service. Enter it with no trailing slash. This host will change: the default is today's GitHub Pages fallback, the service moves to a Cloudflare Pages host next and to a Mage-OS custom domain after that, so expect to update this value. A custom domain also needs matching entries in the module's etc/csp_whitelist.xml if you use either remote mode below.

column1: How the catalog reaches the browser. The server-side proxy fetches the feed once per cache period and serves it from this shop, so admin browsers never contact the directory host. "Direct" has each admin browser fetch the directory host itself, which requires CORS on that host and the hosts listed in the module's etc/csp_whitelist.xml.

column1: Where the directory user interface script is loaded from. The bundled copy ships with this module and is served from this shop's own origin. Loading it from the directory host picks up interface updates without a module release, but needs the host whitelisted for script-src.

column1: How long the proxied feed is served from cache before it is revalidated against the directory host's manifest. The catalog is rebuilt once a day, so an hour is plenty. Used only in server-side proxy mode.
